images.title: The diagonals of a parallelogram bisect each other
images.purpose: Shows parallelogram EASY whose diagonals AY = 10 cm and ES = 6 cm cross at O, cutting each other into 5 cm and 3 cm halves.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One large parallelogram in the centre with its two unequal diagonals and their halves marked.
images.exact_structure: One parallelogram EASY in dark outline, vertices in order E, A, S, Y going round, with E at bottom left, A at bottom right, S at top right and Y at top left. The top side YS is shifted to the left of the bottom side EA, so Y sits further left than E and the shape leans to the left; AY is clearly longer than ES, about 10 to 6. The long diagonal AY is a thick teal (#0072B2) line and the short diagonal ES is a thick amber (#E69F00) line, crossing at O, marked with a small filled reddish purple (#CC79A7) dot; the diagonals are not at right angles. Half diagonals OA and OY each carry one short tick mark; half diagonals OE and OS each carry two short tick marks. The label 5 cm sits beside OA and the label 3 cm beside OE. The letters E, A, S, Y sit outside their corners and O beside the crossing. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: The diagonals of a parallelogram cut each other in half, but they need not be equal.
images.description: Shows parallelogram EASY whose diagonals AY = 10 cm and ES = 6 cm cross at O, cutting each other into 5 cm and 3 cm halves.
images.context: AY = 10 cm, ES = 6 cm; OA = OY = 5 cm, OE = OS = 3 cm (ASA on ∆AOE and ∆YOS).

image_decisions.why: Two clearly unequal diagonals with equal halves show the bisecting property without equality.
